summary.const: Imported approval context is not supported

remediation.const: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a context-bearing approval at {1} (approval '{2}'). Approval context is dropped on export (LB-1) and cannot be re-bound on import, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated. Use a context-free approval.
